verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes an implementation-relevant audio-level acceptance condition for the task-local video ads.
The client replaces the general audio-level condition with the more specific Audio DB 18 production criterion; the existing key is updated without leaving a stale attribute.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Please list every agreed detail in the offer, including appropriate cuts and Audio DB 18 applied according to proper standards. You can send the offer to me, and I will accept it.

ambiguity.description: The Audio DB 18 acceptance criterion lacks the measurement convention and reference level needed to implement and verify the exact audio target.
